choice.clique_anchored_symmetry_breaking: CHOSEN (gated headline, arm P2). A new encoding, certify/20p: every round, compute the EXACT maximum apartness clique C of the observed positions (branch and bound, node cap declared); pin x[c_i]=i for the sorted clique; keep first-visit symmetry clauses only for non-clique positions and states q > |C| over non-clique earlier positions; make n < |C| UNSAT with one contradiction clause; keep apartness pair clauses; rebuild the pool when the max clique grows. Exactness: any model can be relabelled so the clique gets 0..|C|-1 and the rest appear in first-visit order (Inferred, relabelling argument; checked by the CNF reference audit and the replay fidelity gate).
choice.why: The frozen pool (A16, after the 041 audit) has NO fixed colours: PoolE1.lower() is 1 and symmetry breaking is first-visit only, so every size below the clique needs a pigeonhole-like UNSAT proof. CLIQUE_DIAG_063 (exploratory) shows the exact max clique on the sealed 062 records is 17-18 against the greedy 16. Pinning it removes the |C|! relabellings and makes small sizes trivial.
